posts.trend: Karnataka liquor volumes flat in H1 as beer gets three cheers
posts.context: The 30-year-old body can no longer process hard spirits without severe, multi-day physiological consequences.
posts.angle: Switching to mild beer is not a lifestyle choice; it is a treaty signed under duress with your own liver.
slides: At twenty-five, you bought whiskey to celebrate.

At thirty, you buy beer because your liver has a union.

Three pegs of neat rum now require:
One day of planning.
One electrolyte packet.
Two business days of quiet recovery.

You didn't choose the lighter drink.

It was a court order.
posts.caption: Send this to the person who still suggests "one quick shot" at 11 PM. 🙄
posts.rank_verdict: The final slide lands on a clunky corporate metaphor about a union and a court order rather than a flat, deadpan reality.
